metadata.task: Exercise scoring, grouping and abstention reporting on authored examples; not predict engagement.
metadata.positive_label: 1 = authored example intended to contain a concrete opening idea; 0 = authored generic introduction. These are subjective fixture labels, not observed outcomes.
metadata.provenance: Twelve synthetic examples authored for this repository by Codex during evaluation-tool development. Account names are fictional grouping identifiers. No text, metrics or labels were collected from Instagram or YouTube.
